name: A Tanka boat raised up on piles at the water's edge
summary: The Tanka boat is raised high upon wooden props at the water's edge; other propped-up boats, converted for use as dwellings, are sketched in behind, one with a ladder set against it.  A group of boatpeople is seen on the right.

collection.museum: 维多利亚与艾尔伯特博物馆
